steps.clueRiddle:
Green walls, wrong turns, and one way out.
Two runs — your only rival is you.
steps.clueReveal: Who can escape the maze? Run the hedge maze at Domaine de Maizerets. Then run it again.

challenges.title: Maze Escape: Two Runs
challenges.instructions: Start the stopwatch and run the hedge maze. Write down your time. Run it again and go faster.

challenges.title: Backup Mission: Garden Hunt
challenges.instructions: Do this only if the maze is closed today. Explore the gardens and playground. Find all five.
checklist: A duck or another water bird
The playground — go down the slide

steps.funFact: This park's old estate goes all the way back to the early 1700s.

steps.clueRiddle:
The longest road of the race starts now.
Games in the car will make it shrink.
steps.clueReveal: Drive west on Autoroute 20 toward Ontario. Play the full game lineup.

challenges.title: Canoe the Rapids
challenges.instructions: Drag your finger to steer the canoe. Dodge every rock. Survive sixty seconds.

challenges.title: Hedge-Maze Training
challenges.instructions: Practice for the big maze. Drag your racer to the red exit gate. No cutting through hedges!

challenges.title: Dinosaur Road Trivia
challenges.instructions: Answer questions about dinosaurs and the road home. Guess before you tap.

challenges.title: Homeward Bingo
challenges.instructions: Look out the window the whole drive. Stamp what you spot. Get four in a row.

steps.funFact: Autoroute 20 turns into Highway 401 when you reach Ontario.

steps.clueRiddle:
A highway stop guarded by giant lizards.
They are huge, they are old, they don't bite.
steps.clueReveal: Stop for lunch at Madrid 2.0. Count the dinosaurs and pose with one.

challenges.title: Dino Census
challenges.instructions: Walk all the way around the stop. Count every dinosaur statue you find.

challenges.title: The Scariest One
challenges.instructions: Choose the scariest dinosaur there. Stand right beside it. Make your bravest face.

challenges.title: Dino Brain Test
challenges.instructions: Three quick dinosaur questions. Take your best guess. No looking it up!

trivia.q: Which dinosaur had a long neck for reaching treetops?
trivia.funFact: Brachiosaurus grabbed high leaves like a giant, scaly giraffe.

trivia.q: How many horns did a Triceratops have?
trivia.funFact: Triceratops means "three-horned face" in ancient Greek.

trivia.q: What do we call a scientist who digs up dinosaur bones?
trivia.funFact: Paleontologists brush rock off bones very, very slowly.

steps.funFact: The old Madrid rest stop was a Québec road-trip legend for decades.

steps.clueRiddle:
Smoke drifts over a park beside the river.
Bring a napkin. Bring ten napkins.
steps.clueReveal: Go to Ribfest at Hardy Park. Judge the ribs, then hit the Kids Zone.

challenges.title: Judge's Table: Ribs
challenges.instructions: Try the ribs and fill in the scorecard. Score each part out of five. Be honest!
challenges.photoPrompt: Snap a picture of you eating it!

challenges.title: Kids Zone Mission
challenges.instructions: Pick one Kids Zone activity. Finish the whole thing.

steps.funFact: If you stay past dark, fireworks may light up the river.

steps.location: St. Lawrence College Residence & Conference Centre
steps.clueRiddle:
One more mat before the finish line.
Sleep fast — tomorrow you race home.
steps.clueReveal: Check in at the St. Lawrence College Residence. Step onto the pit stop mat.
steps.funFact: Tomorrow is the final leg. First place is still possible.

pitStop.hotelName: St. Lawrence College Residence & Conference Centre
